retail.title: Tukaamada & Suuqyada Waaweyn
retail.description: POS degdeg ah, kayd otomaatik ah, iyo nidaam barcode ah oo kaydka iyo lacag-qaadista hagaajiya.

wholesale.title: Jumladaha & Qaybinta
wholesale.description: Maamul bakhaarro badan, amarrada iibsiga, iyo logistics — dhammaantood hal nidaam.

services.title: Adeegyada & La-talinta
services.description: CRM macaamiisha, biilal otomaatik ah, iyo la socodka kharashka.

manufacturing.title: Warshadaha & Dharka
manufacturing.description: Bill of Materials, work orders, iyo silsiladda sahayda si cad oo la maamuli karo.

support.title: Taageero joogto ah

grow.title: Taageero & kobocin

About.title: Ku saabsan KeydTech
About.subtitle: Hirgeliyaha Odoo ee ugu horreeya ee ku yaal Muqdisho, Soomaaliya.
About.story: KeydTech waxay ka caawisaa tukaamada, farmashiyada, dukaamada elektarooniga, jumlada, iyo shirkadaha adeegga inay ka baxaan spreadsheet-yada iyo qalabka kala fog — una gudbaan hal nidaam Odoo oo isku xiran. Waxaan isku darnaa khibrad badeecadeed iyo fahamka ganacsiga maxalliga ah.
About.mission: Inaan nidaamyada ganacsiga heerka adduunka ka dhigno kuwo la heli karo, wax ku ool ah, oo faa'iido u leh ganacsatada yaryar ee Soomaaliya.

clarity.title: Cadeyn

reliability.title: Kalsooni
reliability.description: Nidaamyo u adkaysta maalmaha suuqa ee mashquulka badan iyo xisaabinta bilaha.

partnership.title: Wada-shaqeyn
partnership.description: Waxaan guuleysannaa marka kaydkaaga, iibkaaga, iyo lacagahaagu si wanaagsan u socdaan.
